{{Top|ca|leg}}
{{Quote|(Galactic horticulturists and mythologists would certainly be interested to learn that the legendary Silver Forest of Dreams does exist and is, in fact, located on Kubindi.)|Obo Rin, ''Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy''|<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>}}
A '''mythologist''' was a type of specialist. One subject of interest to mythologists was the [[Silver Forest of Dreams]],<ref name="GG4" /> a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] of giant [[Tree/Legends|trees]]<ref name="RisingForce">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]''</ref>&mdash;the location and even existence of which had acquired legendary qualities by the time of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;that was located on<ref name="GG4" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ku'Bakai system/Legends|Ku'Bakai system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]]. The [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]] noted in an entry of his publication ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]'' dedicated to the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that the actual existence of the Silver Forest of Dreams, as well as its location on Kubindi, would be of interest to both mythologists and [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[horticulturist]]s.<ref name="GG4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The occupation of mythologist was introduced in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise via ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook authored by [[Troy Denning]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG4" /> In the real world, a mythologist is an expert in mythology,<ref name="Mythologist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/mythologist|text=MYTHOLOGIST Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com, LLC]]|archivedate=20241112163637}}</ref> that is, the study of [[Wikipedia:Myth|myths]].<ref name="Mythology">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/mythology|text=MYTHOLOGY Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com, LLC]]|archivedate=20250126220216}}</ref>
